Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The new skill entry matches the implemented coolant tool. It states the required arguments, five modes, accepted aliases, refusals, undo, and machine warning behavior. The decision record explains the scope. The body includes `Process change: yes`. This PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local results against upstream/main `a529c455352d8c2d228e3dd83d0e5d42a91ea9b0`:

- The trial merge passed. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `python3 .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/tests/test_coolant.py`: PASS, 1 test.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: PASS, 0 steps.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 0 steps, 0 failures. The xtask build passed.
- Rust suites and clippy do not apply because no Rust crate changed. The gate does not select the Python test; it ran separately.
- The documentation test failed with the old upstream skill text: `missing set_operation_coolant tool row`. It passed with the fixed text before and after this check. This check used memory and changed no files.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: PASS.

Requested before merge: none.

This PR changes no runtime G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, geometry, UI, or goldens. It does not require a safety-tier review or UI screenshots. Runtime MCP behavior and physical machines were not tested. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
